description.value:
A next-generation evolution of Arasaka’s ‘Origami,’ the Tamaetomo is more of the same, but better in every way. It’s more accurate, smarter, hits harder, looks better, and even costs more. Plus, it can still fold up to fit under a jacket. For modern archers, the Tametomo is the true stepping stone between amateur and pro.

Cost: 1,750eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Bow • Skill: Archery • Range: Longbow

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No (While unfolded)

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Reinforced String, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: Without an Action, this weapon can be folded or unfolded. While folded, this weapon is Concealable but cannot fire.

Range: Longbow
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Reinforced String, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
